subStrands.name: Fitness, Posture, and Track and Field

objectives.description: Define physical fitness and describe its components including cardiovascular endurance, strength, flexibility, and agility
Demonstrate correct posture and movement in standing, sitting, and walking activities
Perform basic track and field events including sprints, relays, and field events applying correct techniques
Conduct and participate in a physical fitness test and interpret results
Explain the relationship between regular exercise, nutrition, and physical well-being
Demonstrate basic skills in ball games including football, basketball, volleyball, and handball
Distinguish between contact sports (football, boxing, rugby) and non-contact sports (tennis, badminton, athletics) with examples
Apply basic skills and techniques in contact and non-contact sports including tackling, blocking, and passing
Describe the benefits of participation in sports including physical fitness, teamwork, and social interaction
Explain personal hygiene practices and their role in preventing disease and maintaining well-being
Describe the determinants of health including heredity, environment, lifestyle, and access to healthcare
Identify and describe common communicable diseases, their modes of transmission, and prevention methods
Describe non-communicable diseases, their risk factors, and strategies for prevention and management
Explain the effects of drug use, misuse, and abuse and describe prevention and counselling strategies
Describe sexually transmitted infections (STIs), their consequences, and prevention strategies
Explain environmental pollution, its types, and measures to protect the school and community environment
Identify common causes of accidents in home, school, and sports environments and describe safety precautions
Describe types and causes of sports injuries and apply appropriate first aid treatment
Demonstrate first aid procedures for common injuries including cuts, sprains, fractures, and burns
Describe the safe use of protective equipment in contact and non-contact sports
